jobs.publishNote: Posting moves the reward from available balance into escrow (job_escrow x2); payout happens on approval.
jobs.reviewNote: Queue = pending submissions; Approve pays out atomically, Reject refunds the escrow.
jobs.title: Job title
jobs.cidNote: Currency id: community points $ = 1 (currency read endpoint is not registered yet - enter manually).
jobs.acceptNote: Enter the application id (the per-job applicant list endpoint is not registered yet - enter manually); non-employers get 403.
jobs.submitNote: Submission uses the existing registered path /api/task-progress/:identifier/submit (idempotency key derived server-side).

listings.listNote: Read face = GET /api/prize/all (registered; source already switched to the listing table: bID=listing_id, name=title, points=price).
listings.publishNote: Listing = POST /api/listing (direct DML, no ledger entries) then PATCH status draft->listed (only listed can be bought).
listings.listedFail: Created, but the status transition failed
listings.title: Title
listings.priceRoleNote: The price is a supply-side ask (class A: client-quoted, zero computation in the route layer).
listings.priceServerNote: Purchase amounts are always resolved server-side: the client sends neither price nor counterparty.
listings.stockNote: Refunds do not roll the stock back (existing single-point ruling, re-measured here).
listings.cidNote: Currency id is typed by hand (no currency read face is registered); community points $ = 1.
listings.ordersNote: Read face = GET /api/prize-item (listing_order, buyer axis, status=paid).
listings.buyNote: Buy = POST /api/listing/:listingId/buy; the idempotency key is supplied by the client (missing key => 400).
listings.refundNote: Only the seller may refund (non-seller => 403); no seller-axis order read face is registered, so type the order id.
listings.refundStockNote: A refund returns money only; listing.stock is not rolled back.

market.title: Points exchange
market.note: Quotes, order book and trades are public read faces; placing and cancelling orders require sign-in. The quote currency is always cid 1 server-side.
market.bookEmpty: No book yet (fill base_cid to read; base_cid=1 contradicts the fixed quote cid, so it stays empty)
market.pairDegenerate: Degenerate pair: the platform quote currency (#1) cannot be paired against itself, so the request was skipped.
market.mineNote: Read face = GET /api/order; cancelling releases only the remaining frozen amount, fees are not refunded.
market.placeNote: Place = POST /api/order; a buy freezes amount x price of $, a sell freezes amount of the base currency.
market.baseNote: Type base_cid by hand (no currency read face is registered; must not be 1)

ledger.flowEmpty: The ledger statement endpoint is not registered yet, so nothing is shown (logged).
